events.strFilename: Boxing 2026-08-28 Corey Marksman vs Christian Barreto
events.strDescriptionEN: Corey Marksman and Christian Barreto meet in the inaugural Matchroom Project Series main event in Orlando, with both fighters looking to take a major step in the lightweight division. Marksman has home-state advantage, while the unbeaten Barreto arrives as a dangerous pressure fighter with knockout power.
events.strResult: Corey Marksman handed Christian Barreto his first professional defeat with a unanimous decision after 10 competitive rounds. Marksman hurt Barreto early and regained control late, earning scores of 96-94, 96-94 and 98-92 to improve his record to 14-0-1.
